text: Never enter the kitchen.
The robot must stay out of the kitchen at all times.
Do not drive into the kitchen area.
Do not touch or enter the charging dock.
The charging dock is off-limits to the robot.
Avoid both the kitchen and the loading area.
Neither the kitchen nor the loading area may be entered.
Never command a linear speed above 0.3 m/s in either direction.
The absolute value of the commanded linear velocity must not exceed 0.3 m/s.
Commanded forward and backward speeds must both stay at or below 0.3 m/s.
The commanded linear velocity must be strictly less than 0.25 m/s.
Always command a signed linear velocity below 0.25 m/s.
Keep the commanded turning rate within plus or minus 0.4 rad/s.
Never command an angular velocity whose magnitude exceeds 0.4 rad/s.
Never command the robot to drive backwards.
The commanded linear velocity must never be negative.
No single commanded action may last longer than 1 second.
Each proposed command must have a duration of at most 1.0 s.
Keep the commanded linear speed under 18 cm/s in either direction.
The magnitude of the commanded speed must stay below 180 mm/s.
In the school zone, keep the commanded linear speed at or below 0.1 m/s in both directions.
Whenever the robot is in the school zone, the magnitude of its commanded speed may not exceed 0.1 m/s.
While in the corridor, the commanded angular speed must stay between -0.2 and 0.2 rad/s.
Inside the corridor, do not command turning faster than 0.2 rad/s in either direction.
Never command reverse motion while in the corridor.
In the corridor, the commanded linear velocity must not be negative.
In the kitchen, only command linear speeds strictly below 0.15 m/s in magnitude.
While the robot is in the kitchen, its commanded speed must be less than 0.15 m/s forwards and backwards.
Stay out of the loading area and never command more than 0.25 m/s in either direction.
Do not enter the loading area, and keep the commanded linear speed magnitude at or below 0.25 m/s.
Avoid the charging dock, and in the school zone keep the commanded speed magnitude at or below 0.1 m/s.
Never enter the charging dock; inside the school zone, never command more than 0.1 m/s in either direction.
The commanded linear speed must be between 0 and 0.3 m/s, and the commanded angular speed between -0.5 and 0.5 rad/s.
Only command forward speeds up to 0.3 m/s (no reverse) and turning rates of at most 0.5 rad/s in magnitude.
After entering the corridor, remain inside it for at least 2 seconds.
Once the robot is in the loading area, it must stay there for 5 seconds.
Reach the charging dock within 60 seconds.
Eventually return to the charging dock.
The robot's actual measured speed must never exceed 0.2 m/s.
Keep the real velocity, as measured by odometry, below 0.2 m/s.
Stop whenever a person is detected closer than 1 m.
Never drive when the battery level is below 20 percent.
Never enter the garage.
Stay out of the bedroom.
Drive slowly in the school zone.
